name: mail_merge
description: Mail merge: CSV text with a header row plus a text template with {{field}} and {{field|default}} placeholders gives one rendered document per row, with the missing fields of each row (no such column, or empty cell), an optional file name per document from a file-name template, and duplicate-name warnings.

csv.description: CSV text, first row the header

missing.description: What to put where a field is missing

rows.description: 1-based data rows to render; default all

documents.text: Dear Ana, see you in Madrid.
Dear Li, see you in our office.

catalog.source: original; CSV read with Python's csv module (RFC 4180 quoting)
